    A universe-local ordinary-quiver presentation #

    The ordinary quiver is naturally indexed by a small finite type, whereas the public bound-quiver presentation bundle places its coefficient field, algebra, and vertex type in one universe. We therefore transport the exact ordinary kernel attached to any ordinary-arrow representative system to ULift of the projective labels. Path reindexing preserves length, so admissibility and the quotient realization are unchanged.
